labels.description: The count of manufacturing facilities operated by the Company's subsidiaries changed from 64 to 63; the rest of the section is unchanged.
labels.rationale: criterion 4: a count of manufacturing facilities changed (64 to 63), which is a quantitative change other than a date roll-forward.

labels.description: The source of the counterfeit harm was restated from 'the industry's failure to mitigate the threat of counterfeit medicines' to 'the threat of counterfeit medicines' itself, dropping the condition that industry mitigation fails.
labels.rationale: criterion 3: the risk is no longer contingent on an industry mitigation failure, so its scope widens from a conditional risk to an unconditional one.

labels.description: Only the headline changed: 'We are subject' became 'The Company is subject' and 'may materially adversely affect' became 'may have a material adverse affect'; the body text is identical.
labels.rationale: minor: stylistic rewording of the headline with identical meaning, and 'material' is present in both versions, so no criterion applies.

labels.description: The list of consequences of product concerns now reads 'safety alerts, field actions, such as product recalls' instead of 'safety alerts, product recalls', adding field actions as a broader category with recalls as one example.
labels.rationale: criterion 3: scope widened from product recalls to field actions generally (corrections, removals and similar actions), which is a broader stated exposure.

labels.description: The opening sentence dropped the reference to tax changes 'as led by the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development' and to 'the enactment by certain EU and non-EU countries, and the anticipated enactment by additional countries, of a global minimum tax', now saying only changes 'in the U.S. and around the world, including global minimum taxes'.
labels.rationale: criterion 2: a named program and organization (the OECD-led global minimum tax initiative) and the EU and non-EU jurisdictions enacting it are dropped from the disclosure.
